description: Poll an inbox until a new message arrives. Use after triggering an email verification, OTP, or signup confirmation. Returns the parsed message — including the extracted code and the link to open — as soon as it lands, or a timeout result.

require_code.description: Keep waiting until a message carries an extracted code or action link

subject_contains.description: Only match messages whose subject contains this text (case-insensitive)

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before giving up (default: 120)

name: wait_for_message
